VisitorProfile.title: VisitorProfile
VisitorProfile.description: Persistent cross-visit visitor record keyed by visitorId and validated by visitorToken, summarizing returning visits, explored options, and recent activity without PII.

visitorId.description: Persistent browser visitor identifier matching the document ID.

visitorToken.description: Persistent visitor ownership token preventing third-party tampering.

currentSessionId.description: Most recent browser tab session identifier.

visitCount.description: Total number of distinct browser sessions recorded for this visitor.

totalEvents.description: Total number of tracked views and interactions recorded for this visitor.

isReturning.description: True once the visitor returns on a subsequent session.

lastEventType.description: Category of the latest interaction or impression.

lastEventName.description: Canonical machine-readable identifier of the latest event.

lastLabel.description: Human-readable label of the latest option or action.

lastInterestCategory.description: Latest inferred interest segment for the visitor.

lastCourse.description: Optional latest program or age-tier associated with this visitor.

exploredOptions.description: Bounded summary list (max 25) of unique options, cards, and sections loaded or clicked by this visitor.

visitedScreens.description: Bounded summary list (max 20) of routes visited by this visitor.

deviceSummary.description: Readable non-PII device platform, screen, and GPU hint.

firstSeenAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of the visitor's initial arrival.

lastSeenAt.description: Server timestamp of the visitor's most recent activity.

VisitorEvent.title: VisitorEvent
VisitorEvent.description: Immutable event stored inside /visitors/{visitorId}/events/{eventId} capturing every route, loaded Home option, and click without PII.

visitorToken.description: Visitor ownership token matching the parent visitor document.

visitNumber.description: 1-based visit number when this event occurred.

eventType.description: Category of interaction or option impression.

optionKey.description: Optional identifier of the card, tier, video, or option loaded/clicked.

label.description: Human-readable option, screen, or CTA label.

course.description: Optional program or tier associated with the event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event occurred.

AnalyticsEvent.title: AnalyticsEvent
AnalyticsEvent.description: Legacy flat analytics event collection (admin read/delete only).

/visitors/{visitorId}.description: Persistent returning-visitor profile documents. Created/updated with matching visitorToken proof and bounded arrays; readable/deletable only by verified admin.

/visitors/{visitorId}/events/{eventId}.description: Append-only behavioral events nested under each visitor's ID so all actions across visits accumulate under the same user record. Requires matching parent visitorToken; readable/deletable only by verified admin.

/events/{eventId}.description: Legacy analytics events archive. Admin-only read/delete.
